description: SEC EDGAR filings for a US-listed company by ticker or CIK, newest first, optionally filtered by form type (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 4, S-1...). Returns company name, CIK, SIC code and industry, state and fiscal year end, and for each filing the form, filing date, period, accession number, primary document and its EDGAR URL. Source: SEC submissions feed. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, up to 10 digits

form.description: Form type filter, comma-separated allowed: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 4, S-1, DEF 14A, 13F-HR (optional)

ticker.description: Stock ticker, e.g. AAPL (ticker or cik is required)

name: sec_filings
title: sec_filings
